body:
Built the real King spawn/respawn telegraph (NORTHSTAR §22.5 gap #1): pulsing disc+ring for the last 5s before a King spawns, matching existing R-zone-circle rendering convention. Fixed a latent bug found while wiring it (not-yet-spawned King x/z were always 0,0). Confirmed §22.5's camp-buffs gap was already closed by the Four Heavenly Kings system (built after that analysis, not by this session). Re-read spec-2 and found a new, previously-unflagged gap: GridCell.population is tracked but never read/written by tick_automata -- spec-2's population/pressure automata mechanics aren't wired in. Logged as a new open question (needs a real design pass) rather than guessed at. build.sh + test_arena.sh clean, 1188 PASS, no regressions. Commits de1504a, e52832a.

⚓ ☃
title: Iterated on ECOWAR per EMILY.wiki spec-1/spec-2: King spawn telegraph shipped, camp buffs confirmed done, new automata gap found
